stations.title: Ines
stations.say: Ten stamps, then a free candle?

stations.title: Shop site
stations.note: A slow guide, repeat emails too.

captions: Theo has his answers. Next, Ines wants a stamp card in every parcel.
The site forgets between calls, so the tenth stamp counts for nothing.
You write three helpers that remember, in three tasks.
Now the tenth stamp earns a free candle, and the card starts again.
One idea, three fixes: a stamp card, a faster guide, one welcome email.
